Re-measured at 6 of 482 for issue #226: the page now also paints the active run's SUMMARY and the stored audio/input settings at construction, so the two cases that pin those fail here too. Re-measured at 9 of 495 (route-host.test.ts 62 + loop.test.ts 433) for issue #324's step S5, and the GROWTH is the step's whole point rather than test churn: the gameplay session used to paint Records, the earned set and the three paint-shop swatches at its own construction, so four loop.test.ts cases about those boot echoes passed with this block deleted. With the session's duplicates gone the page is the only writer, and removing its paints is now visible to them too.
